Retrospective Cohort Study of Outcomes for Neonates and Infants Undergoing Inguinal Hernia Surgery at Multiple Australian and New Zealand Hospitals: The RetroNeo Study.

Statistical Analysis

Author

Dr Benjamin Moran, MBBS, BMedSci (Hons), MMedStats, FCICM, FANZCA

Published

December 11, 2025

1 Introduction

This is the statistical analysis that accompanies the RetroNeo study, which examines the anaesthetic techniques and perioperative outcomes of neonates and infants undergoing inguinal hernia surgery.
